goalTextEn: Can read a short role profile and understand basic job information.
goalTextKr: 짧은 직무 소개를 읽고 기본적인 직무 정보를 이해할 수 있다.

introduce.goalEn: Can read a short role profile and understand basic job information.
introduce.goalKr: 짧은 직무 소개를 읽고 기본적인 직무 정보를 이해할 수 있다.
introduce.situationEn: You read a short profile card about a coworker’s job and responsibilities.
introduce.situationKr: 동료의 직무와 책임에 대한 짧은 프로필 카드를 읽습니다.

tutorNotes.text: "Today, we will practice can read a short role profile and understand basic job information.."
Read the lesson goal aloud. Ask the student to repeat.
"Is it clear?"
Read the situation. Check the student understands.
"Let's go to the next part."
Encourage the student to speak in full sentences with a polite tone.

vocabulary.definition: the position or function you have in a company
in charge of; having the duty to do something
a section of a company (e.g., Sales, HR)

pronunciation.instruction: Let's practice /r/ and /l/ in role words.

tutorNotes.text: "Let's learn the key patterns for today."
Read each pattern aloud. Ask the student to repeat.
Teach vocabulary with short examples.
"Now, let's practice pronunciation."
Focus on polite tone and clear key words.

understand.instruction: Fill in the blanks with the correct pattern. Then practice the pattern drills.
understand.instructionKr: 빈칸에 올바른 표현을 넣고, 패턴 드릴을 연습하세요.

examples.en: I work in the Sales department.
I work in the HR department.
I am responsible for client emails.

tutorNotes.text: Do the fill-in-the-blank first.
Run drills with substitutions.
Keep the student speaking in full sentences.

steps.title: Step 1 - Repeat After Me
steps.content:
1. I work in the Sales department.
2. My role is sales support.
3. I am responsible for client emails.
4. I work with the marketing team.
5. I have been here for 2 years.
6. Nice to meet you.

tutorNotes.text: Read each line clearly. Student repeats.
Correct one key pronunciation point at a time.

steps.title: Step 2 - Personalize It
steps.instructionEn: Complete the lines with your own information.
steps.content:
1. I work in the _______________ department.
2. My role is _______________.
3. I am responsible for _______________.
4. I work with _______________.
5. I have been here for _______________ years.
6. Nice to meet you.

tutorNotes.text: Have the student fill in first, then read aloud.
Encourage realistic names, departments, and tasks.

steps.title: Step 3 - Dialogue Practice
steps.instructionEn: Practice this dialogue with your tutor.

dialogue.en: OK. I work in the Sales department.

tutorNotes.text: Do it once reading, then once naturally.
Switch roles if time allows.

steps.title: Step 4 - Free Speaking
steps.instructionEn: Speak freely using at least 5 sentences.
steps.content:
Include:
- Read 3 role sentences clearly
- Explain one sentence in your own words
- Identify department + role + responsibility
- Answer 2 comprehension questions
- Summarize the profile

tutorNotes.text: "Speak without notes. Keep it natural."
Give feedback after the student finishes.

challenge.scenarioEn: Read a coworker profile and explain their department, role, and responsibility.
challenge.scenarioKr: 동료 프로필을 읽고 부서, 역할, 담당 업무를 설명하세요.

guideQuestions.text: Use one full target pattern sentence.

tutorNotes.text: "Challenge time. Use today's patterns naturally."
Success = polite tone + correct patterns + clear meaning.

discussion.instructionEn: Choose one category and answer the questions.

categories.title: JOB ROLES
questions: Is your role clear in your company?
What task do you do every day?

categories.title: TEAMWORK
questions: Which team do you work with most?
Do you use email or chat more?

categories.title: INTRODUCTIONS
questions: What job info do you share first?
Do you prefer short or detailed introductions?

tutorNotes.text: "Now, a short discussion."
Discuss for 3-5 minutes.
